controls.name: C-21d
controls.query:
FROM logs-squid.access-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-06-30T07:06:53.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-07T07:06:53.000Z"
| STATS requests      = COUNT(*),
        first_seen    = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen     = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY source_ip = source.ip,
           identity = user.name
| SORT requests DESC
| LIMIT 10
